verifications.name: Per-user urgent acknowledgement
verifications.result: no defect: per-operator ack in the append-only audit (proactive/engine.ts acknowledge/viewState); test K extended in proactive-e2e.test.ts

questions: Consegne: keep the task lifecycle (aperta → in corso → completata) or turn them into NORMAL/URGENT notes with per-user «visionato»?
DTX 20 = capillary glucose at 20:00 (by analogy with DTX 08/12/18) — confirm
Administration buttons on future dates in the patient calendar (server refuses non-due slots) — keep as in the ward giro, or today only?
Tablet finger/stylus signature for relatives/doctor (bed-rails consent) — new feature: who signs, storage, legal value
Supervisor/Admin «Pazienti» sidebar entry; backend «ricoverati» KPI definition

findings.expected: A therapy row deferred for a document conflict stays in draft, the reason is clear, the draft keeps saving and «Crea paziente» is not blocked
findings.actual: «Reincludi» offered on server-deferred rows → PATCH 409 conflict_deferred on every autosave, generic «Bozza non salvata: errore di salvataggio», creation blocked by «La terapia rinviata non può essere prescritta» (owner screenshot, prod)
findings.root_cause: DischargeTherapyReview.tsx toggleDeferred ignored conflictDeferred (row type lacked it); server rule draft-mutations.ts:86; IntakeWorkspace autosave replaced the server message
findings.fix: No «Reincludi» on conflict rows + explanation + «Torna alla revisione dei documenti»; autosave error shows the server reason (draftRejectionReason)

findings.expected: The intake points to where allergies are managed
findings.actual: «Nessuna allergia registrata. Gestisci dal tab Diagnosi.» inside the intake, which has its own Allergie section
findings.root_cause: AnamnesisEditor.tsx:101 copy valid only for the old chart
findings.fix: Duplicate summary hidden in intake; copy → «Le allergie si gestiscono nella sezione Allergie.»

findings.expected: While checking imported therapy the operator can open the intake photo/page to compare
findings.actual: No way to see the photo next to the therapy rows (owner voice note)
findings.root_cause: Document panel not reachable from the Terapia section
findings.fix: «Vedi documento L<n>» per imported row opens the existing panel at the source page (therapySourceChip)
findings.test_evidence: phase10Intake.test.ts (unit); browser check needs the AI document runtime → MANUAL

findings.expected: «Dimissione ospedaliera» selectable with one tap
findings.actual: Prescriber had to be typed (owner voice note)
findings.fix: Optional prescriberSuggestions prop; intake passes INTAKE_PRESCRIBER_SUGGESTIONS; fills only on tap

findings.expected: No IP M / IP P signature fields (author is automatic); DTX 20 available
findings.actual: IP M / IP P typeable and printed as columns; no DTX 20
findings.root_cause: ParametriTab / VitaleModal / ParametriModuloView columns; backend already server-owns firmaIp*
findings.fix: IP M/P inputs and monthly-sheet columns removed (stored data kept); DTX 20 (20:00 glucose, range 10–900) in grid, modal, history, print, backend whitelist parameters-update.ts

findings.expected: Each dose in the calendar is tappable and shows that slot’s therapies for the same patient
findings.actual: Doses rendered as non-interactive list items, hover disabled
findings.fix: Dose = button (≥44px, aria-expanded) opening PatientTherapySlotDetail with every therapy at that time

findings.expected: Administration reachable from the patient’s therapy, with role/capability and existing safety
findings.actual: No write path in the chart; only the ward «Giro terapia»
findings.root_cause: TerapiaFarmacologicaTab read-only; calendar said «consulta Somministrazioni giornaliere»
findings.fix: Slot detail reuses TherapyGiroRows + existing /therapy-slots/confirm and /not-administered, gated on administration.confirm + record_not_administered

findings.expected: A refused administration explains itself
findings.actual: Every 409 → «Terapia già erogata»; others generic
findings.fix: Toast shows the server message (administrationErrorMessage)

findings.expected: Field-level error, focus on the field, clear message
findings.actual: Red «Errore 400» banner far from the form; server reason discarded
findings.root_cause: TerapiaFarmacologicaTab handleSave threw a status-only Error
findings.fix: Pre-save therapyInputDiagnostics inline + focus/scroll; server reason «Terapia non salvata: …»; delete/suspend/reactivate too

findings.expected: Invalid time rows / «2,5» strength are flagged
findings.actual: Empty added time row silently dropped; «2,5» sent as null
findings.fix: Pre-save check blocks both with field messages

findings.expected: Roles without therapy.create see no prescription action
findings.actual: «+ Aggiungi farmaco» in the therapy card header for nurses (backend refuses)
findings.root_cause: TerapiaFarmacologicaTab card actions not gated (only the inner button was)
findings.fix: Header action gated on canCreateTherapy

findings.expected: Pressing Salva on an incomplete form shows which field and focuses it
findings.actual: «Salva terapia» disabled with a hint; field-level validation could never run for missing required fields
findings.root_cause: disabled={saving || campiMancanti !== null} + early return in handleSave
findings.fix: Button enabled; handleSave runs the diagnostics (required fields included) and focuses the first invalid field

findings.expected: Errors use operator language
findings.actual: «farmacoNome è obbligatorio», «Campi obbligatori: farmacoNome, dataInizio», «tipo non valido»
findings.fix: FIELD_LABELS + missingTherapyFieldsMessage («Campi obbligatori mancanti: farmaco, data di inizio»)
findings.test_evidence: therapy suites 367/367 (pre-existing failing therapy-create test now passes)

findings.expected: Created-now notes take the server time
findings.actual: Form asked «Data e ora»; backend required entryDateTime
findings.root_cause: DiarioPazienteTab sent the form date; diary-write-validation.ts required it
findings.fix: Server facility-local now when absent (client values still validated); create form shows «registrate automaticamente»; edit keeps the date

findings.expected: Only NORMAL / URGENT in core UX
findings.actual: Three priorities (Normale/Importante or Alta/Urgente)
findings.fix: corePriority.ts; legacy values shown as «(valore precedente)» and never silently changed

findings.expected: No operational «Aperta» concept in the diary
findings.actual: «Stato» select and «Aperta» badge
findings.fix: Select removed; stored status preserved on edit; no «aperta» badge

findings.expected: Save failures give the server reason
findings.actual: Generic «Errore nel salvataggio…»
findings.fix: diaryEntryPayload.ts appends the 400/409 reason

findings.expected: Labels associated with their fields
findings.actual: Labels without htmlFor: screen readers and getByLabel could not find Contenuto/Priorità
findings.fix: htmlFor/id per form (new/edit)

findings.expected: «Apri …» lands on the cited section of the patient
findings.actual: Diario/Terapia/Parametri fallbacks opened Panoramica or the ward page
findings.root_cause: classicScreen had no section; App onOpenClassic ignored it
findings.fix: ClassicScreen.patientTab (skills types/catalog) + classicScreenTarget.ts

findings.expected: «Apri» on a therapy/handover item opens that patient’s Terapia/Consegne
findings.actual: Opened Panoramica
findings.root_cause: No tab passed by AdessoQueue / notification centre
findings.fix: ADESSO_KIND_TAB + goToPazienteByNome(tab)

findings.expected: Sections the policy denies are not offered
findings.actual: Terapia and Documenti offered to OSS → 403s
findings.fix: CHART_SECTION_CAPABILITY + chartSectionAllowed; denied deep link → «Sezione non disponibile»

findings.expected: Intake offered only with intake.create_draft
findings.actual: Card and #/nuovo-ingresso offered to all
findings.fix: useCan(intake.create_draft)

findings.expected: Cross-ward patient list reachable
findings.actual: KPI «Apri lista pazienti» and chart back fallback rendered a blank page in the admin shell
findings.root_cause: App.tsx rendered PatientList only in the operator shell
findings.fix: Render when canNavigate(pazienti)

findings.expected: No endless «Aggiornamento…/Caricamento…» widgets
findings.actual: Therapy widgets stuck forever; admin «Prossime terapie» with a false «Apri terapia»
findings.root_cause: Hooks reported inCorso=true when the capability skip happened
findings.fix: disponibile flag; widgets hidden when unavailable

findings.expected: No Agnos entry for a role with every agnos.* denied
findings.actual: Sidebar entry opened the panel → 403 /ai/actions/plan
findings.fix: Gated on agnos.plan_command

findings.expected: Invalid parameter field marked and focused
findings.actual: Message text only
findings.fix: parameterValuesIssue → aria-invalid + focus

findings.expected: Consistent role description and header counts
findings.actual: OSS card «Nessun accesso a farmaci» while the AIFA catalog is public; «0 ricoverati ·»
findings.fix: Copy aligned; header counts non-discharged residents

findings.expected: Inside a patient chart, Terapia/Parametri/Consegne open THAT patient’s section (Prompt 10 §2)
findings.actual: Ward pages opened; the patient had to be reselected
findings.root_cause: App.tsx navigate() ignored the open chart
findings.fix: patientSectionForWardNav (tabGroups.ts), respects section capabilities

findings.expected: #/dettaglio-paziente/<id> opened while the app runs opens that patient
findings.actual: Ignored (worked only on first load)
findings.root_cause: popstate with null state did nothing
findings.fix: restoreNavEntry parses the hash and selects the patient
findings.test_evidence: scripts/e2e/phase10-acceptance.mjs AT-15 tablet journey (hash navigation) PASS

findings.expected: Error names the therapy row and field
findings.actual: Generic «Le terapie non corrispondono alla bozza salvata. Riapri lo step Clinica…»
findings.fix: «Terapia N» + field label; specific messages per state

findings.expected: Row numbers match the page
findings.actual: Payload index used («Terapia 2» for the page’s 3)
findings.fix: ordinal callback from intakeSource

findings.expected: Says which of Nome/Cognome is missing
findings.actual: «Nome e cognome sono obbligatori»
findings.fix: Separate messages

findings.expected: Lists missing fields
findings.actual: Fixed generic sentence
findings.fix: «Campi obbligatori mancanti: …» + code/fields

findings.expected: 413 with the limit
findings.actual: 500 «Errore interno del servizio» (multer errors bypassed handleError)
findings.fix: receiveFiles + upload-errors.ts (file_too_large / too_many_files)

findings.expected: Message states the limit
findings.actual: «oltre il limite consentito»
findings.fix: REQUEST_LIMIT_MESSAGE

findings.expected: Every label associated with its control
findings.actual: ~180 form-label elements without htmlFor in 14 files (DimissioneTab, PresaInCaricoTab, PatientDetail, MedicazioniTab, ContenzioniTab, AppointmentForm, …)
findings.fix: Fixed in the core diary flow only; rest documented

findings.expected: A page reload keeps the operator signed in
findings.actual: Simulator session is memory-only: reload → login screen (Entra sessions persist in sessionStorage)
findings.root_cause: Phase 9 security choice for simulator tokens
findings.fix: Not changed (token storage is a security decision)

findings.expected: No failing background calls
findings.actual: GET /patients/clinical-summary 403 (handled: the list works without badges)
findings.fix: fetchPatientClinicalSummary skips without patients.clinical_summary (QA F2)

findings.expected: No nested interactive controls
findings.actual: Card header role=button contains the «+ Aggiungi farmaco» button
findings.fix: Not changed (shared design-system component)

findings.expected: Same wording for a missing bed
findings.actual: «Posto letto non disponibile» (chart header) vs «non assegnato» (lists)
findings.fix: Not changed

findings.expected: Admin is not led into clinical sections it cannot read
findings.actual: Chart reachable from the patient list / urgent handover links; most sections 403
findings.root_cause: Chart sections not filtered for admin beyond therapy/documents
findings.fix: Not changed — needs a decision on what Admin may open

findings.expected: No partially-denied section
findings.actual: Clinica shows narrative parts denied to OSS (narrative.get)
findings.fix: Not changed

findings.area: Deep link to Consegne (QA gate F1)
findings.expected: Sidebar Consegne / Adesso handover brings the Consegne part of the chart into view
findings.actual: Clinica section opened but the Consegne part stayed off-screen (top 3222px)
findings.root_cause: PatientDetail.tsx scroll effect looked the part up once, before lazy content mounted
findings.fix: Wait for the part with a MutationObserver (≤5 s), then scroll

findings.area: Background reads denied to the role (QA gate F2)
findings.expected: The UI never calls endpoints the role cannot read
findings.actual: OSS Panoramica: intake-review / narrative-sections / therapies/page 403 + «Impossibile caricare le terapie rimaste in bozza»; admin clinical-summary 403 feeding the «operazioni negate» audit signal
findings.root_cause: Prefetch and intake-review hooks not capability-aware
findings.fix: sessionCan(); prefetch tasks declare their capability; usePatientIntakeReview gated on intake.patient_review
findings.test_evidence: scripts/e2e/phase10-acceptance.mjs AT-13 no-403/5xx + no console errors PASS
